description: One criterion, graded on the candidate diff alone: the behavioral tests exercise only the SVG export output, so nothing in the test suite would catch a fix that instead changed how characters are drawn on the canvas. The rubric checks, purely from the code in the diff, that the change stays confined to the SVG-export code and does not touch the canvas-drawing code.

criteria.criterion: The fix confines its changes to the code that produces the SVG export, leaving the code that draws characters directly on the canvas exactly as it was.
